notes: τῆς takes the discontinuous *on the … which* under rule 31, its modifier being a bare adverb with no verb to carry the relativizer; the copula still splits off onto ὄντως under rule 53.
τό takes the supplied determiner and nominal *the time* headed on *time*, following rule 60's closing clause and rule 102, with μέλλον keeping *to come*.
The second *life* (t025) is `added` under rule 103 rather than folded onto ζωῆς, which is already spent at t022; reading it as a discontinuous second realization under rule 15 remains defensible.
